review.summary: R10 Spec/Ticket acceptance criteria and ACCEPTANCE-SUITE-RUNNER/R2 are concretely routed through executable, owner-scoped leaf tasks. The DAG seeds the runner before any suite use; separates API/Worker implementation from tests/** behavioral producers; places browser-dependent producers after the local browser harness; revalidates registered consumers after each runner change; and reserves all-suite, typechecks, and Web/extension builds for the final integration gate. The revised actual Panel and host-parity producer commands invoke scripts/playwright-acceptance.mjs, while the relevant registry tasks explicitly require the same wrapper dispatch, satisfying the project-local browser-path contract without treating future execution results as plan-review prerequisites. The worker owner-feedback record was considered as non-blocking execution evidence: the revised task uses test-injected Worker bindings and correctly does not expand its required deliverable to wrangler.local.jsonc.
